status: prospective; frozen before candidate source, build, capture, and result observation
priority: OLE2 and OOXML first; ODF deferred until the OLE2/OOXML optimization goal completes; iWork excluded
scope: Source-backed XLSX cell-value edit/save with one private provenance merge candidate; complete validation, preservation, fallback, and publication behavior remain authoritative

target.hypothesis: A checked linear merge of the address-ordered parsed and omitted-source cell sequences can remove redundant sorting and duplicate scanning while preserving every Store field, derived index, extent, error boundary, and fallback route.
candidate_boundaries: Retain complete rewritten-output validation and reduced readback.
Retain source/parsed eligibility checks and the omission producer.
Refuse an uncertain ordering, overlap, collision, row invariant, count, reservation, or allocation condition and use the complete parser.
Preserve all Stored provenance, rows, columns, defaults, merge ranges, indexes, bounds, source identity, cancellation, execution, and publication checks.
Do not add persistent metadata, unsafe code, ambient I/O, global parallelism, or candidate-specific allocation growth.
target.required_mechanism: Fresh positive owner and leaf attribution is required after a numeric pass; a missing or inlined symbol is not zero-cost evidence.

shape_purpose.medium: Four ordinary 48x48 worksheets with fixed media members.
shape_purpose.dense-sparse: Dense, strided sparse, and diagonal worksheet locality at the larger 128x128 scale.
shape_purpose.noncompact: Alternating qualified XML forms and lexical preservation.
shape_purpose.vendor-extension: Opaque extension XML/binary parts and a relationship preservation control.

workloads.case_shape_rule: Every listed case runs once per listed shape. An inapplicable row requires a retained typed receipt and cannot be silently omitted.

sidecar.scope: One isolated benchmark process for one case and one shape; the sidecar is diagnostic and does not replace benchmark elapsed samples.

order: candidate R2: all 32 rows in reverse matrix order
baseline R2: all 32 rows in reverse matrix order, output stage baseline and execution stage candidate

allocation.order: The same four ABBA legs and 32 case-shape rows as normal timing.
allocation.scope: Measured source-backed planning, staging, combined staging+commit, commit-core, and publication intervals, with their exact counter/endpoints/peaks. Internal temporary destruction within each phase is included. Final returned-object destruction, fixture construction, correctness oracles, and report assembly outside those intervals are not attributed to the phases. Eager allocation vectors are unavailable; every child still has process RSS evidence.
allocation.phase_boundary: The staging vector ends after the final edit.set; the commit-core vector begins immediately before edit.commit() and ends after its returned value; the combined vector retains the original enclosing interval.

noise.purpose: Descriptive baseline-only run used to freeze the primary improvement floor; it is not a candidate result and cannot be substituted by an older repeat or profile.

threshold.status: pending baseline noise; candidate output must not be observed before this record is frozen

noise_definition.N: The largest absolute relative p50 change across the 8 primary rows between baseline noise R1 and R2.
noise_definition.row_requirement: Both p50 values must be positive finite nanosecond values; retain the row that determines N.
noise_definition.instability_rule: If N > 5.0 percentage points, the pilot is too unstable for an adoption decision. Retain both noise repeats and stop the candidate gate; do not rerun noise to seek a smaller N.

threshold.floor_units: percentage points; 50000 is nanoseconds and matched_baseline_p50_ns is nanoseconds, so 100 * 50000 / matched_baseline_p50_ns is a percentage-point value
threshold.stable_pilot_rule: Only when N <= 5.0 percentage points may the computed floor be frozen and candidate output be collected.
threshold.paired_primary_gate: For each of the 8 primary rows in each paired repeat, candidate_p50_ns <= matched_baseline_p50_ns * (1 - primary_floor_percent / 100). The matched baseline is R1 for candidate R1 and R2 for candidate R2.
threshold.primary_mean_gate: Each primary mean must not increase by more than 5% in either paired repeat.
threshold.control_gate: Every control p50 and mean must not increase by more than 5% in either paired repeat.
threshold.rss_gate: Every retained process-RSS comparison must not increase by more than 5%; report each case-shape child sidecar without synthesizing an unscoped group value.
threshold.allocation_gate: Every reported allocation metric row for every case-shape child and repeat must not increase by more than 5%, including calls, reallocations, bytes, live endpoints, and region peak for each available source phase vector. The combined interval remains a separate diagnostic and is not added to either split interval.
threshold.allocation_unavailable_policy: Source-backed XLSX reports plan, staging, combined staging+commit, commit-core, and publication phase vectors. Eager controls omit allocation vectors in the harness JSON; the analyzer must explicitly record that absence as unavailable, with native elapsed and process RSS controls retained. No unavailable or absent field is a measured zero. These phase vectors do not measure all workflow allocations.
threshold.adverse_review: Retain and individually review every absolute adverse or same-build drift above 5%; no selective rerun, mean-only rescue, geometric-mean masking, or post-result threshold relaxation.

gate_lanes.native_timing: native only; primary and control elapsed p50/mean admission gates
gate_lanes.allocator_timing: allocator diagnostics only; no elapsed admission gate
gate_lanes.process_rss: native and allocator per-case-shape child sidecars
gate_lanes.allocation_metrics: allocator only; source-backed phase vectors when measured; eager is unavailable

capture.output_stage: The folder holding the retained binary and child output.
capture.execution_stage: The source manifest checked before and after the live child; baseline R2 intentionally uses output stage baseline with execution stage candidate.
capture.guard_asymmetry: The output-stage guard validates the retained manifest file, lock identities, and before/after manifest immutability without comparing output-stage source hashes to live source. The execution-stage guard validates its manifest against the current full source path set and hashes before and after every child.
identity_requirements: Full source manifest for crates, tools/perf-baseline, workspace manifests, toolchain, and relevant cargo configuration.
Ignored workspace Cargo.lock, retained workspace-Cargo.lock copy, and workspace-lock.json binding.
Binary hash before and after every binary-backed child.
Output-stage and execution-stage manifest hashes and full before/after guard records.
Plan and driver hashes, exact argv, selected environment, timing, exit status, and artifact hashes.
capture.no_overwrite: Every evidence path is opened or reserved exclusively before a child starts. A colliding receipt, host record, stdout/stderr, JSON, catalog, or time sidecar aborts before execution.

source_guard_test.when: After baseline and candidate manifests are frozen and before the first candidate build or capture.
source_guard_test.proof: The retained baseline output manifest is accepted in manifest-only scope while the candidate execution manifest is checked against live source; a synthetic execution digest mutation is refused without mutating repository files.

quality.runner: The driver check action binds an arbitrary argv to a frozen stage; callers record any command-specific environment such as RUSTDOCFLAGS in the receipt.

profiling.rule: Positive timed attribution with caller ancestry, including an inline mapping if the target symbol is absent, is required for adoption.

hardware.status: optional diagnostic; not an admission gate or a portability claim
hardware.owner: Root may retain a separately receipt-bound probe if the environment permits it.

required: Strict address ordering and duplicate refusal for both input sequences.
Ordered non-overlapping one-row omission rectangles and source/parsed collision refusal.
All Stored fields, rows, columns, defaults, merge ranges, cell_rows, merge index, and three cell bounds match the complete parser.
Checked count/reservation and allocation-failure fallback retain existing error precedence and publication behavior.
No-op source sharing, exact output bytes, malformed/unsupported fallback, source conflicts, cancellation, execution interruption, and partial sink failure retain their existing behavior.
Full workspace and feature quality checks pass for the selected candidate and restored baseline if the candidate is rejected.
correctness.disposition: Reject and restore the baseline on any mandatory gate failure; preserve all measurements, failures, drifts, and review records.

exclusions: No ODF or iWork work in this campaign.
No cold-cache, hardware-independent, physical-device, remote-provider, native-producer, or scaling claim.
No adoption from a profile-only improvement, a missing symbol, a lower instruction count, or an absent allocation field.
